'''Bob Bob's lightsaber combat deck''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Bob]]
* '''Published:''' 5 December 2001 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Theed Palace]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Let Them Make The First Move|Ref3-D-letthemmakethefirstmove.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Let Them Make The First Move
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PTheed FirstMove Bob DS 2001 GPN.txt |Download]]

with a combo of mual and vader i can master to naboo site and kill a character every turn. Unless they are playing jedo ofcorce then i have to win in lightsaber combat
